A thoughtful argument other than the disdain and bigotry for Native Americans whose union of tribes actually influenced Franklin's own push for our union!


Ryan Grim (@ryangrim)

Harold Meyerson flags that founding father Benjamin Franklin made a persuasive argument for the wealth tax, in a letter to Robert Morris, then the richest man in America and the financier of the revolution. 

His basic argument: Public laws and society made you rich, so the public can decide what to do with the wealth
